about: Passengers and envoys. The 'galactic alliance' becomes the five colonies' customs talks, the never-happening 'system rebellion' becomes the Gamma miners' strike (it waited on a stat the game never raises), the alien scholar becomes Matylda Korinek, a human archaeophysicist, and the VIP and merchant visits get places they can actually happen.

deacon.name: Deacon Amaro
deacon.about: Solarian reading-house at Barnard's Star; reads sunspots, and trade routes in them

pilgrims.name: Pilgrims of the Broken Machine
pilgrims.about: cargo cult founded by the crew of a hauler that broke down at an outpost; worship ships, tip in spare parts

solarian_friend.about: the captain donated to the Solarian reading-house

carried_the_pilgrims.about: the captain flew the Broken Machine pilgrims to Alpha

pass.deacon.title: The deacon's reading
text: Deacon Amaro of the Solarian reading-house at Barnard's Star needs passage to Alpha. The reading-house has logged the star's spots for forty years, and the deacon reads trade routes in them, for a donation.
'Avoid Gamma on even cycles,' the deacon says. Over the next year this is right more often than your broker.

choices.say: Just fly the deacon to Alpha

pass.pilgrims.title: Pilgrims
text: Six pilgrims of the Cult of the Broken Machine want to ride a working hauler to Alpha, to see where ships come from.

They pray to your reactor twice a day and leave offerings in the airlock: bolts, ration bars, a fuel pump for a ship two models older than yours. Nobody touches the controls. They are very clear that nobody touches the controls.

diplomatic_envoy.name: Envoy Ines Halloran
diplomatic_envoy.about: Alpha's colonial council; wants one customs code for five systems

rebel_commander.name: Teodor Brann
rebel_commander.about: spokesman of the Gamma free miners

ancient_scholar.name: Matylda Korinek
ancient_scholar.about: archaeophysicist at the Stellar Institute; first to say the builders' metal was a ring around our own Sun; still right in Cargo 2

meet.galactic_alliance.title: The envoy
meet.galactic_alliance.text: Envoy Ines Halloran of Alpha's colonial council books your best cabin and asks whether you have a better one.

galactic_alliance.1.title: One customs code
galactic_alliance.1.text: The five colonies are drafting a common customs code. Haulers would pay one fee instead of five. Nobody has asked the haulers. Halloran is asking you, on the record.

galactic_alliance.2.title: The delegation
galactic_alliance.2.text: Forty delegates, eleven languages and one argument about seating. The delegation booked your ship because you are the only captain none of them has sued.

meet.system_rebellion.title: The Gamma miners
meet.system_rebellion.text: The free miners at Gamma have stopped shipping ore to the legions. The good rock is gone, the flares cook the drills, and the legions still want the same tonnage.
notes: repair: waited on controlled_locations >= 2, a number the game never raises; now follows the customs talks

system_rebellion.1.title: A passenger in the coolant tank
system_rebellion.1.text: Teodor Brann, the miners' spokesman, needs to reach the customs talks without the legions noticing. He fits in a coolant tank if he breathes shallowly and stops talking. One of these is harder for him.

system_rebellion.2.title: Sheet music
system_rebellion.2.text: The miners need air scrubbers, medical stock and, according to the manifest, nine crates of sheet music. Do not open the sheet music.

meet.ancient_mysteries.title: Korinek
meet.ancient_mysteries.text: Matylda Korinek buys passage with research credits and a promise. She has traced the builders' metal to a segment turning on its own in the wake of Scholz's Star, the Builder Site, and wants to stand on it herself.

ancient_mysteries.1.title: What it took
ancient_mysteries.1.text: She brings a spectrometer, a folding chair and a bottle she says is for afterwards. 'Seventy thousand years ago this star passed close enough to our Sun to steal from it,' she says. 'I want to see what it took.'

visit.vip_passenger.text: Your reputation precedes you, Captain. So does your cabin rating.
notes: repair: the game compared the location type (planet, outpost...) with 'port', which never matches; this should spawn on a port visit

visit.merchant_trader.text: Rare goods for discerning customers. Some for undiscerning ones too; those are cheaper.
notes: repair: compared the location type with 'port' or 'cantina'; this should spawn on a port or cantina visit
